results.title: (PDF) Post-editing of machine translation: Processes and ...
results.content: This article presents a review of the evolution of automatic post-editing, a term that describes methods to improve the output of machine translation systems, based on knowledge extracted from datasets that include post-edited content. A Comparative Study of Human Translation and Machine Translation with Post-editing. The research resulted in the development of a machine translation post-editing system. Qualitative Analysis of Post-Editing for High Quality Machine Translation. In the context of massive adoption of Machine Translation (MT) by human localization services in Post-Editing (PE) workflows, we analyze the activity of post-editing high quality translations through a novel PE analysis methodology. This article presents the view of three professionals and researchers in the translation field about the post-editing task with a view to examining what it is known about this relatively new task both in the localization industry and in the academic arena, as well as highlighting what should be investigated further in order to shed light on different aspects of post-editing and the use of machine translation.
